name: Magazine cover: three-quarter rise
when: The voice quotes a magazine interview ("told LOVE magazine: ..."). The shot racks into a levelled blur, the real cover rises into frame as a printed magazine and turns into a three-quarter view on the right; who said it and the quote are one block on the left. Needs the real cover of that issue, never a mock-up.
anchor: The scene starts on the outlet's name ("told LOVE"): the magazine rises from frame 2 and lands at frame 17, the attribution rises from frame 12, the quote lines from frame 15.

vars.theme: clean or vice: the video's theme
vars.cover: the real cover of the issue quoted, an image file (jpg/png/webp, any size and ratio; 1000 px tall or more). Never generated or redrawn
vars.shot: the clip under the scene: the same shot as the footage at this moment, cut to the scene's length, in the project's assets/. It dissolves into the blurred ground and comes back at the exit
vars.who: who said it, the words before the outlet: Rob Nelson told. 26 characters at most; empty with an empty outlet = no attribution line
vars.outlet: the magazine as the voice names it (LOVE), set in the heavy weight after `who`; 18 characters at most
vars.quote: the quote as the voice says it, sentence case, without quotation marks (they are added and hung in the margin). Wrapped into up to 3 balanced lines at 96 px, down to 72 px for a long one; 54 characters at most
vars.out: seconds after the start: when it starts to leave; the shot is sharp again 0.4 s later (default: scene length - 0.4)

source: algrow-gta-pipeline/lab/newanims/kit/templates/magcover-A (validated 16 Nov, clean + vice; demo in lab/newanims/magcover_demo)
changed: New animation, validated by the owner on 16 Nov (A over B/C). Ground = the validated nametag-C levelled blur, with a 3 % push.
